slides.heading: Chikungunya (Viral Arthritis)
slides.subtitle: A mosquito-borne viral illness marked by fever and severe joint pain.

terms.definition: Arthralgia — severe joint pain, especially small joints.
Rash — maculopapular, often starting on the face.

slides.heading: Diagnosis & Treatment (FECCS)
bullets: Diagnosis: ELISA (IgM & IgG anti-chikungunya antibodies); RT-PCR for genotyping.
Fever/pain: paracetamol — AVOID NSAIDs (ibuprofen, aspirin) until dengue is ruled out.
Encourage oral fluids (ORS, water, juice); Complete rest in the acute phase.
Chronic arthritis may persist weeks–months; Severe/neurologic cases → refer to hospital.
No specific antiviral; no commercially available vaccine (IXCHIQ available in the US only).

slides.heading: Mosquito-Borne Prevention — 4 S's
bullets: Search and destroy breeding sites; Seek early consultation; Self-protection measures; Support fogging.
Repellents: DEET, Picaridin, Oil of Lemon Eucalyptus.
Treat mosquito nets twice a year; fogging only during outbreaks (early morning/late afternoon).
Biologic control: larvivorous fish (Gambusia/mosquito fish, Tilapia), frogs, neem & eucalyptus.
TREC: Treatment, Report (weekly), Early detection, Casefinding.

slides.heading: Key Takeaways
bullets: Aedes-borne virus; hallmark = severe joint pain (arthralgia) + rash.
Paracetamol for pain; avoid NSAIDs until dengue is excluded.
Supportive care only — no specific antiviral or local vaccine.
Prevent with the 4 S's and biologic vector control.
